title: Stop Saying "Very Heavy"! 3 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very heavy". Use one of these words instead:
• Massive: Mia lifts a big box. It's massive.
• Hefty: She drops it on her foot. Ouch! It's hefty.
• Back-breaking: She moves boxes all day. It's back-breaking work.

Comment your own word for "very heavy"!
